temel.soru: Sipariş kalemi başına ortalama kargo ücreti ne kadar?

temel.soru: Ağırlığı 10 kg'dan fazla olan kaç ürün var?
Kaç değerlendirmede yorum metni yazılmış?
Ödeme yöntemlerine göre kaç ödeme yapılmış?
temel.sql:
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS ödeme_sayısı
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

temel.soru: Kredi kartı ödemelerinde taksit sayısına göre ortalama ödeme tutarı nedir?
temel.sql:
SELECT payment_installments, AVG(payment_value) AS ortalama_tutar
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

temel.soru: Satıcıların en çok bulunduğu 5 şehir hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT seller_city, seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici
FROM sellers
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: 10`dan fazla satıcısı olan eyaletler hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici_sayisi
FROM sellers
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

temel.soru: Ürünlerin fotoğraf sayısına göre dağılımı nedir?
temel.sql:
SELECT product_photos_qty, COUNT(*) AS sayi
FROM products
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

temel.soru: En az 100 değerlendirmesi olan kategoriler arasında ortalama puanı en düşük olan 5 kategori hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       AVG(r.review_score) AS ortalama_puan
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) >= 100
ORDER BY 2 ASC
LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: Geç teslim edilen siparişlerin ortalama puanı,zamanında teslim edilenlerinkinden ne kadar farklı?
temel.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_gec_teslim_puani,
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_zamaninda_teslim_puani,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) - 
     AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END)) AS fark
FROM orders
JOIN order_reviews ON orders.order_id = order_reviews.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

temel.soru: Ciroya göre en iyi 5 satıcı eyaleti hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: En çok sipariş alan ürün kategorisi hangisi?
temel.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

temel.soru: SP eyaletindeki müşterilerden gelen toplam ciro ne kadar?
temel.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered';

temel.soru: Ortalama kargo ücreti en yüksek 5 ürün kategorisi hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       AVG(oi.freight_value) AS ortalama_kargo_ücreti
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: 2018'de verilen ve teslim edilen siparişlerin sipariş ayına göre sayısı nedir?
temel.sql:
SELECT 
  date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS siparis_ayi, 
  COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders
WHERE 
  order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  AND order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

temel.soru: 2017'nin son çeyreğinde toplam ciro ne kadar?

FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-10-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

temel.soru: Kasım 2017'de en çok siparişin geldiği gün hangisi?
temel.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS gun, COUNT(*) AS siparis
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

temel.soru: Siparişler ortalama kaç saatte onaylanıyor?
En az 10 siparişi olan satıcılar arasında, siparişleri kargoya vermesi ortalamada en uzun süren 5 satıcı hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT o.seller_id, AVG(o.order_delivered_carrier_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS ortalama_kargo_suresi
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
AND oi.order_item_id >= 10
GROUP BY o.seller_id
ORDER BY ortalama_kargo_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: Yıllara göre ortalama sepet tutarı nasıl değişti?
temel.sql:
SELECT 
    date_trunc('year', order_purchase_timestamp) AS yil,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

temel.soru: Birden fazla siparişi olan kaç müşteri var?

temel.soru: Geçen yıl kaç müşteri ilk siparişini verdi?
temel.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers
WHERE customer_unique_id IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
AND customer_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
);

temel.soru: Teslim edilen siparişlerin yüzde kaçının tutarı ortalama sipariş tutarının üstünde?

FROM order_items oi

temel.soru: 2017'de her ay sipariş sayısı bir önceki aya göre yüzde kaç değişti?

  date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ay,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis_sayisi,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) / LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS degisim_yuzde
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
AND oi.order_item_id >= 10
GROUP BY o.seller_id
ORDER BY ortalama_kargo_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

duzeltme.soru: Teslim edilen siparişler tahmini tarihten ortalama kaç gün önce teslim ediliyor?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM order_estimated_delivery_date - order_delivered_customer_date) / 86400) AS ortalama_geri_kalmis_gun
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

duzeltme.soru: Geçen yıl kaç sipariş verildi?
Birden fazla siparişi olan kaç müşteri var?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers
JOIN orders USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY customer_unique_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) > 1;

duzeltme.soru: Sipariş başına kalem sayısının dağılımı nedir (1 kalemli, 2 kalemli...)?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS kalem_sayisi
FROM order_items
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY kalem_sayisi;

duzeltme.soru: 2017'de her ay sipariş sayısı bir önceki aya göre yüzde kaç değişti?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT 
  date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ay,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis_sayisi,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) / LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS degisim_yuzde
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

duzeltme.soru: Müşteriler kaç farklı eyalette oturuyor?
duzeltme.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_state) FROM customers;

duzeltme.soru: Ağırlığı 10 kg'dan fazla olan kaç ürün var?
Ödeme yöntemlerine göre kaç ödeme yapılmış?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS ödeme_sayısı
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

duzeltme.soru: Satıcıların en çok bulunduğu 5 şehir hangileri?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT seller_city, COUNT(*) AS satici
FROM sellers
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5;

duzeltme.soru: Ürünlerin fotoğraf sayısına göre dağılımı nedir?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT product_photos_qty, COUNT(*) AS sayi
FROM products
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

duzeltme.soru: Geç teslim edilen siparişlerin ortalama puanı,zamanında teslim edilenlerinkinden ne kadar farklı?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_gec_teslim_puani,
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_zamaninda_teslim_puani,
    ABS(ortalama_gec_teslim_puani - ortalama_zamaninda_teslim_puani) AS fark
FROM orders
JOIN order_reviews ON orders.order_id = order_reviews.order_id
WHERE order_reviews.review_score IS NOT NULL;

duzeltme.soru: En çok sipariş alan ürün kategorisi hangisi?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

duzeltme.soru: Ortalama kargo ücreti en yüksek 5 ürün kategorisi hangileri?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       AVG(oi.freight_value) AS ortalama_kargo
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;

duzeltme.soru: 2017'nin son çeyreğinde toplam ciro ne kadar?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-10-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

duzeltme.soru: Siparişler ortalama kaç saatte onaylanıyor?
Yıllara göre ortalama sepet tutarı nasıl değişti?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT 
    date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS yil,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

duzeltme.soru: Ortalama sepet tutarı ne kadar?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT AVG(ortalama_sepet) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(order_items.price) AS ortalama_sepet
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY orders.order_id
) AS subquery;

duzeltme.soru: Geçen yıl kaç müşteri ilk siparişini verdi?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS musteri
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
  AND c.customer_unique_id NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM customers c2
    JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
    WHERE o2.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-01-01'
  );

duzeltme.soru: Teslim edilen siparişlerin yüzde kaçının tutarı ortalama sipariş tutarının üstünde?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN oi.price > (SELECT AVG(oi2.price) FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 USING (order_id) WHERE o2.order_status = 'delivered') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yuzde
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';
